claims.interpretation: Sora web/app closed 2026-04-26 and API closed 2026-09-24. Cause claim about pipeline control was not supported by source.
Black Forest Labs introduced multimodal FLUX 3 July 23 2026. Not proof weights downloadable, GPU ready or 3 modalities exactly synchronized in all contexts.
Runway Gen-4.5 is a real service. Documented 12 credits/second and 2-10 second clips. Not a free long-film solution.
Epic June 2026 calls UE6 an in-development roadmap; June 2026 production release UE5.8. Do not route to UE6 production.
SideFX site reports Houdini H22 materials/talks; ONNX native inference claims not verified here.
MotionMaker exists in Maya docs, but 80% rig compression and 60 FPS are unverified marketing claims.
Nuke 17.0v4 dated 2026-07-28. SmartRoto 4x and Nuke-native Gaussian splat/Griptape claims remain unverified.
Khronos release candidate in Feb 2026 is for 3D Gaussian splats within glTF, not standardized 4D time-varying splats.
40-75% electricity/render savings not evidenced by comparable controlled benchmark.
Claim of official Blender MCP should not imply Blender Foundation endorsement for independent GitHub servers.
